necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising clinical concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation, coded as I48.91 and I47.1. Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms, continuous rhythm correlation via CPT 93229 is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management. This extended monitoring is required to accurately diagnose the etiology of the patient's symptoms and ensure appropriate therapeutic intervention.
